messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@harboragex.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-onboarding@harboragex.com
Date: 2026-11-08T08:22:00-05:00
Subject: Onboarding docs — Harboragex (W-9 attached)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning — attaching our W-9 and vendor profile snapshot (portal ID: HBX-4892). Please confirm once this is in your PO queue and let us know if you need a voided check for ACH.

Attachments: Harboragex_W-9_initial.pdf (application template), vendor-profile-snapshot.png

Best,
Jordan Miles
Head of Finance Operations
Harboragex Inc.
jordan.miles@harboragex.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@harboragex.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs — Harboragex (W-9 attached)

Jordan — thanks for sending these over. Quick heads-up as I'm reviewing: the EIN listed on the W-9 currently (xx-xxx9001) doesn't match the EIN in your portal profile (xx-xxx9008). That mismatch prevents us from validating the vendor in our tax checks and will block PO issuance.

Can you:
- Confirm the legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the PO
- Re-send a signed W-9 that matches the EIN you want on Redwood's vendor record
- Upload a voided check or bank letter for ACH (we need one of these to accept ACH payments)

Kimberly — flagging for procurement intake; if we get corrected W-9 + ACH, can we complete a conditional PO within 3 business days?

Jordan — if the earlier W-9 came from an external accounting consultant, a corrected signature page is usually sufficient; happy to accept a DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@harboragex.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding docs — Harboragex (W-9 attached)

Forwarding checklist notes for procurement team — see inline.

--- Forwarded message ---
On Nov 8, 2026, Rachel Kim wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for sending these over. Quick heads-up as I'm reviewing: the EIN listed on the W-9 currently (xx-xxx9001) doesn't match the EIN in your portal profile (xx-xxx9008). That mismatch prevents us from validating the vendor in our tax checks and will block PO issuance.

Procurement intake: if vendor returns corrected W-9 + ACH form, we need to: 
- Confirm legal entity and address against Form W-9
- Validate EIN against IRS/TIN database (procurement will run automated check)
- Collect voided check or bank letter (bank letter preferred for wire/ACH)
- Create provisional PO and mark "pending final finance validation"

If vendor can provide DocuSign + bank letter, we can proceed with conditional PO issuance (PROC-4982).

Kim

From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@harboragex.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T11:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs — corrected W-9 + ACH form attached

Hi Rachel / Kim — apologies for the confusion. The initial W-9 was an older template tied to an outbound payroll EIN. I've attached a corrected, signed W-9 that reflects our vendor entity (EIN: xx-xxx9008) and the completed ACH form. The W-9 was signed by our Controller via DocuSign (envelope link below).

Attachments: Harboragex_W-9_corrected_signed.pdf, Harboragex_ACH_Form.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/Harboragex-W9-Envelope
Procurement ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4982 (you'll see the validation step logged)

We can also add a letter from the bank, but it will take 24–48 hours to pull; would you prefer we upload that or wait for the PO to go conditional now and upload the bank letter when available?

Jordan Miles
Head of Finance Operations
Harboragex Inc.

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@harboragex.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T16:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs — corrected W-9 + ACH form attached

Jordan — received the corrected W-9 and ACH form, thank you. I ran a quick portal reconciliation and kicked off the IRS/TIN automated check (ticket PROC-4982 updated).

Next steps (what we'll do on our side):
- Procurement: create provisional PO and set status to "awaiting final finance evidence" (Kim will confirm in Jira)
- Finance: once bank letter/voided check is uploaded, we'll complete final validation and move PO to "active" (expected within 48 hours of receiving the bank letter)
- I'll confirm the PO number and send over the PO + payment terms once active — target: within 3 business days if bank letter arrives promptly

If you can upload the bank letter to the DocuSign envelope or drop it in the onboarding portal, that will shorten the timeline. I'll mark Harboragex as 'Ready for conditional PO' now so you can begin recognizing Redwood as a customer for scheduling.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
